---
title: Inconsistent ladder
format:
  typst: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: false
      - name: expert
        level: 2
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'The group "advanced" is hidden but a group above it is shown'
          count: 1
---
